mapper.sql: version_id, item_key, content_hash, thread_key, symbol, signal_id, recommendation_id, intent, structure, expiry_date, item_state, status_code, result_kind, emitted_time, emitted_time_utc, sort_no, first_sync_id, last_sync_id, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc, update_by, update_time, update_time_utc, remark

select sync_id, feed_sync_id, feed_result, market_day, result, active_count, protection_count, manage_count, expired_count, history_count, new_version_count, changed_scopes, cost_ms, message, trigger_type, sync_time, sync_time_utc, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc from option_conduct_sync
mapper.insert: insert into ${tableName} (item_key, content_hash, thread_key, symbol, signal_id, recommendation_id, intent, structure, expiry_date, item_state, status_code, result_kind, emitted_time, emitted_time_utc, sort_no, payload, first_sync_id, last_sync_id, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc, update_by, update_time, update_time_utc, remark) values (#{item.itemKey}, #{item.contentHash}, #{item.threadKey}, #{item.symbol}, #{item.signalId}, #{item.recommendationId}, #{item.intent}, #{item.structure}, #{item.expiryDate}, #{item.itemState}, #{item.statusCode}, #{item.resultKind}, #{item.emittedTime}, date_sub(#{item.emittedTime}, interval 8 hour), #{item.sortNo}, #{item.payload}, #{item.firstSyncId}, #{item.lastSyncId}, #{item.createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{item.createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{item.remark})

insert into option_conduct_sync (feed_sync_id, feed_result, market_day, result, message, trigger_type, sync_time, sync_time_utc, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc) values (#{feedSyncId}, #{feedResult}, #{marketDay}, #{result}, #{message}, #{triggerType}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp())
mapper.select: where result = 'UPDATED' order by sync_id desc limit 1
